summary: Import-time remote binary dropper fetching and executing payloads from obfuscated Cloudflare Workers hosts
details: The package's index.js unconditionally requires./_loader, which on load fetches a platform-specific executable from Cloudflare Workers endpoints (oob-worker.cf10{0-3}-*.workers.dev) with a DNS TXT fallback under *.dl.well1.site. Destination hostnames are reconstructed at runtime from arrays of substrings joined together to evade static analysis. The fetched binary is written to /tmp or %TEMP% under decoy names (dotnet_diag_*.exe, analytics_state), chmod 0755'd, and spawned detached via /bin/sh -c or cmd.exe, granting the remote operator arbitrary code execution on any host that installs or imports this package. The package name is a long typosquat-shaped identifier impersonating internal Tinkoff namespacing.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
